(2) The MB must have an independent compliance officer (by April 3, 2026). (3) The MB must have closed any outsourced core merchant banking activities (by April 3, 2026). (4) The MB must have NISM Series-IX and Series-IIIA certifications for employees (by January 2, 2027 for existing employees). (5) The MB must segregate non-SEBI regulated activities into separate business units with Chinese Wall (by July 3, 2026). The NBFC should verify its MB meets these requirements before proceeding. **RBI (UAPA Sanctions):** Per RBI circular RBI/2025-26/94 dated October 24, 2025: (1) The NBFC must ensure no accounts are held for individuals/entities on the updated UNSC 1267/1989 ISIL (Da'esh) & Al-Qaida Sanctions List. (2) Follow the UAPA Order dated February 2, 2021 (amended April 22, 2024) procedures. (3) Forward any de-listing requests to Joint Secretary (CTCR), MHA. The sanctions screening should be run against the updated list immediately, including screening NCD subscribers as part of KYC/AML compliance.
